moral.zh: 秋天日照变短、气温变化，叶绿素减少并分解，原本就有的黄色和橙色色素便显现出来；有些叶子还会新形成红色的花青素。
moral.en: Seasonal signals from shorter autumn days and changing temperatures cause trees to make less chlorophyll, while existing chlorophyll breaks down and reveals yellow and orange pigments already in leaves; some leaves also make new red anthocyanin pigments.
